reasoning_content: Negative ProxyPass `!path` also requires a target path. The correct negative form is `ProxyPass !/xplan-mapserver !/xplan-mapserver` or `ProxyPass !/xplan-mapserver /`... Actually, for negative proxy, the form is `ProxyPass !/path !` — hmm. According to the docs: "The negative form of this directive ... ProxyPass !/image1 /images/" — the target is ignored. Let's use `ProxyPassMatch !/xplan-mapserver` — same issue. The correct approach: negative ProxyPass requires the same structure: `ProxyPass !/xplan-mapserver !/xplan-mapserver`? Actually, the docs say: "ProxyPass !/image1 http://www.foo.com/" — the target URI is unused, but must be present. Let's use `ProxyPass !/xplan-mapserver /`.

action.command:
sed -i 's|ProxyPass !/xplan-mapserver$|ProxyPass !/xplan-mapserver /|' /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/xplanbox.conf
apache2ctl configtest 2>&1 | tail -1 && apache2ctl -k restart 2>&1 | tail -1
sleep 3
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "mapserver via apache: %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:8080/xplan-mapserver?request=GetCapabilities&service=WMS&version=1.1.1"
curl -s "http://localhost:8080/xplan-mapserver?request=GetCapabilities&service=WMS&version=1.1.1" | head -c 200
